title: An unplanned conversation finds its life
meaning: An unexpected change can make room for a lively conversation and freedom when the interest that appears does not become a duty to entertain each other.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Wheel of Fortune in the physical position appears as conversation begins or changes direction with circumstances. The Empress in energy encourages you to develop the subject that emerges, add details and let words continue. The Fool in emotions brings lightness and freshness when the exchange need not follow a familiar route. You can freely take up an unexpected thought within an ordinary situation without promising a special evening in advance.

For example, a delayed train leaves extra minutes on the platform. An amusing sign begins a conversation about words you use for everyday things. **An unplanned detail can give a conversation life**. You recall appealing expressions, add your own and laugh at unexpected combinations. The pause becomes full without pretending the delay itself is pleasant. Freshness belongs to your conversation rather than a promise to enjoy every alteration to your plans.

Lightness disappears if every free minute becomes a duty to invent an interesting subject. A changing conversation then turns into an attempt to maintain the mood constantly, while silence feels like failure. The Empress’s constructive direction helps let development find a natural size. A chance detail may bring one amusing remark or a long exchange; communication’s value does not depend on how impressively you filled an unplanned pause together.
